## Project setup hook

A project can now have the agent image run its own "get a fresh clone ready" script
before the agent starts. The feature is opt-in and additive: with `AGENT_SETUP` unset,
the boot is unchanged. There is no image contract change from v0.4.0 (contract 3).

### Added

- `AGENT_SETUP` names a command the project ships, such as `bin/setup --skip-server`.
  After provisioning, it runs in the project directory as the agent user, with the
  firewall already on, an empty capability set, stdin from `/dev/null`, and
  `AGENT_SETUP_PHASE=1` set. None of the staged-secret variables are in its environment.
- `AGENT_SETUP_TIMEOUT` caps the run in seconds (default `600`).
- New exit code `3`: the setup command exited non-zero or timed out. A
  `FATAL — setup failed (exit N): <cmd>` line tells a runner that the failure is a
  project bug, not an image bug. A setup path that is absolute, escapes the project, is
  missing, or is not executable fails with exit `1`.
- Setup runs only in self-clone mode (`AGENT_REPO` set). Provided-workspace mode skips it
  and logs a line saying so.

### Internal

- `smoke.sh` covers `AGENT_SETUP` in a real container.
- Debian base image digest bump; `docker/build-push-action` 7.4.0,
  `docker/setup-buildx-action` 4.4.1 and `docker/setup-qemu-action` 4.4.0 in CI.

### Upgrade

Use `claude-v0.5.0`. To opt in, set `AGENT_SETUP` in the runner's launch environment.
The command must be safe to re-run, because it runs on every boot, including a warm volume.
